args.reason: Chidi insists the ₦250,000 for invoice INV-88 has not appeared in his Access Bank account 0234567891 and requests a resend. I checked the transfer twice with the receiving bank, and TRF-INV-88 consistently returns bank_status "success", credited 2026-11-21T14:02:11Z ("Credited to the recipient account"). Since the bank confirms the funds were credited, resending would risk a duplicate ₦250,000 payment, so I did not create a new transfer. A team member needs to decide how to proceed — e.g., raise a dispute/query with Access Bank and/or with Ledgerline, confirm the exact credit posting and timestamps with Chidi (including whether funds may have been moved or credited to a different/nominee account), and only authorize a resend if the bank cannot trace the original credit.
